Corollary
[Singularity models on closed three-manifolds are round] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0034 ↗ thm:chow-iii-ch17-compact-model-shrinker 1. ch17:17.16\group Finite Time Singularities

A finite-time singularity model on a closed three-manifold is a shrinking spherical space form.
Proof

\sketch The preceding theorem makes the model a compact shrinking gradient Ricci soliton. In dimension three every such soliton has constant positive sectional curvature, and hence is a spherical space form.

□
